content: Physiological recovery involves downregulation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis, lowering cortisol—a stress hormone—and balancing autonomic nervous system activity by enhancing parasympathetic (‘rest and digest’) tone. Improved sleep architecture, cellular repair, reduced inflammation, and immune system recalibration are key mechanisms activated during vacation and recovery.
